title: Load and unload three boxes in Ladder
summary: Count boxes with two CTU blocks to run a fixed batch: load three, unload three, then light Done.
scope: Passing means your program behaved correctly in the simulator on this computer. It says nothing about a real machine, its timing or its safety.
objectives: Count items with a counter that has a preset value.
Use one counter to stop loading and another to know the batch is finished.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/CountedQueue.ld.json, count the boxes at EyeIn with a CTU block of preset 3 and the boxes at EyeOut with a second CTU block of preset 3.
stages.checkpoint: Load one box at a time, stop loading at the third, and light Done when the second counter reaches 3.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, count the boxes: three are loaded, one after the other, and then the belt unloads them.
stages.checkpoint: The belt runs and boxes appear until three have passed EyeIn; Done stays off until the third box has passed EyeOut, and then the belt stops.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then press {{ui:learn.check}}: The starter has no rungs and no counters; load three boxes with a counter at EyeIn, count the unloaded boxes with a counter at EyeOut, light Done when all three are out, and stop the belt then.
stages.checkpoint: Check reports the scenario of this lesson as passed.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: Press Check. ZPLC runs your saved program against the scenario of this lesson, with the plant answering your outputs, and lists every assertion that failed. To watch the plant move, press Run (F5) and open the 3D view.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named counted-queue and contains {{assertions}} assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Watch the boxes enter one by one and leave at the other end; the counters change once per box, not once per scan.
stages.checkpoint: All three boxes are delivered, none is dropped or collides, and Done is on when the belt stops.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: A counter counts rising edges, so a box that stays under a sensor counts once; the final AT assertion pins Done and the stopped belt.
stages.checkpoint: What the assertions check is tested; nothing else is.

hints.text: Place two CTU blocks, each in a rung that starts with the contact of its sensor; set R to FALSE and PV to 3, and bind Q to a variable: it turns on when the count reaches the preset.

Emit a new box on Start and each time the previous box has left EyeIn (a falling-edge contact on EyeIn), until the first counter is done; then Done follows the second counter and Run is Active AND NOT that counter.

faultCases: The starter has no rungs and no counters; load three boxes with a counter at EyeIn, count the unloaded boxes with a counter at EyeOut, light Done when all three are out, and stop the belt then.
